name: SAMBA-M3: Hybrid Sliding-Window Attention and Spectral Mamba Block (Hardene
description: SAMBA-M3: Hybrid Sliding-Window Attention and Spectral Mamba Block (Hardened). Supports: - DistilBERT (Flat MHA) - RoBERTa / BERT (Nested Encoder Self-Attention) - GPT-2 (Causal Decoder with Conv1D) - Qwen / LLaMA (GQA with Rotary Position Embeddings) - True chunked local sliding-window attention (O(L · W)) - No double-residual or double LayerNorm - Safe injection returning None on failure

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
